<description>
`verify_shasums_signature` previously separated signatures into `good_trusted` and `good_untrusted`, but computed `num_trusted = len(good_trusted) + len(good_untrusted)` (and added all `expired` entries under `--allow-expired`). As a result, valid signatures from untrusted keys present in the local GPG keyring satisfied `--min-good-sigs` even when none of them were trusted in GPG or matched `--trusted-keys`.

In addition, `README.md` documents passing full 40-character primary key fingerprints to `--trusted-keys`, whereas `parse_gpg_result` only recorded the key identifier from `GOODSIG`/`EXPKEYSIG` and ignored `VALIDSIG` fingerprints, and did not deduplicate multiple signatures from the same primary key.

Changes:
- Count only distinct, non-revoked trusted signers toward `--min-good-sigs` (including under `--allow-expired`) directly in the signature loop.
- Parse signing and primary key fingerprints from GnuPG `VALIDSIG` status lines so `--trusted-keys` matches full fingerprints while deduplicating by primary key fingerprint.
- Clarify `--trusted-keys` and signer counting in `contrib/verify-binaries/README.md`.
- Extend `test_inactive_signature_quorum` in `contrib/verify-binaries/test.py`.
</description>

<commits>
d1c576b365 contrib: require trusted signers in verify.py

verify_shasums_signature previously added len(good_untrusted) (and all
expired signatures under --allow-expired) into num_trusted, allowing
valid signatures from untrusted keys in the local keyring to satisfy
--min-good-sigs even when --trusted-keys did not match any signer.

Count only distinct non-revoked trusted signers toward the threshold,
match --trusted-keys against full primary or signing subkey fingerprints
from GNUPG VALIDSIG status lines while deduplicating by primary key
fingerprint in the signature loop, and extend the quorum tests in
contrib/verify-binaries/test.py.
</commits>
